exam_scheme.note: NEET-PG is the single national eligibility-cum-ranking entrance examination for admission to MD/MS/PG Diploma and Post-MBBS DNB/DrNB courses across medical colleges in India, conducted by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS). The examination is administered as a Computer Based Test (CBT) comprising 200 multiple-choice questions of 800 marks with a duration of 3 hours 30 minutes (210 minutes). The test paper is structured into time-bound sections (Sections A, B, C, D, E). Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct response, deduction of 1 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking). Qualifying criteria: 50th percentile for General/EWS, 40th percentile for SC/ST/OBC, and 45th percentile for UR-PwD.
